articleTitle: How Birth Control Can Affect Your Mood
imageHeadline: Your birth control might be affecting your mood
imageSubtext: What the research says about hormonal contraception and mood changes
pinTitle: How Birth Control Can Affect Your Mood – What the Research Shows
pinDescription: Feeling flatter or more anxious since starting the pill? The research backs a real connection between hormonal contraception and mood changes — and it depends on which type of hormone you're using. Learn what the evidence actually shows and when switching methods makes sense.
